{{Npcbox | name = Admiral Barean Westwind | image = Admiral Barean Westwind.png | titles = Grand Admiral of the Scarlet Fleet | faction = Combat | affiliation = [[Scarlet Crusade]], [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiras]] | level = 60 | type = Rare Elite | aggro = {{Aggro|-1|-1}} | race = Human | creature = Humanoid | gender = Male | location = [[Light's Point]], [[Scarlet Enclave]] | status = Killable }} '''Admiral Barean Westwind''' is a rare elite [[human]] located at [[Light's Point]] in the [[Scarlet Enclave]]. He was a prominent member of the [[Scarlet Crusade]] and the Grand Admiral of the [[Scarlet Fleet]]. He disappeared off the [[Frozen Coast]] of [[Northrend]], and a statue was erected in his honor in the [[Scarlet Monastery]]'s [[Hall of Champions]]. However, his fleet emerged once more, making berth at Light's Point along the eastern shores of Lordaeron. Although he survived his expedition to the frozen north, [[Lost Crewman|his]] [[Wallowing Crewman|sailors]] have not fared as well. ==Loot== * [[Fleetmaster's Cane]] * [[Fleet Scimitar]] * [[Westwind's Bicorne]] * [[Sash of the Northrend Expedition]] * [[Sivaxis Tundra Shard]] * [[Mariner's Cuffs]] * [[The Frigid Star Ring]] * [[Jacket of the Scarlet Admiral]] ==Hall of Champions Plaque== {{Book||width=25em|content= Admiral Barean Westwind
